name: AttachRolePolicy Allowed but unconditionally Denied in the same policy (NOT a path)
note: An unconditional, in-scope explicit Deny of iam:AttachRolePolicy overrides the Allow (AWS explicit-Deny precedence). The principal cannot attach any policy, so the ATTACH-POLICY escalation does not exist as a capability of this policy and must not be flagged. Verifies same-policy explicit-Deny precedence in the escalation engine.
